newsitem.title: USA: Yields on Bond Buyer's weekly indices edge down.
newsitem.headline: Yields on Bond Buyer's weekly indices edge down.

text.p: Yields on the Bond Buyer municipal bond indices edged down this week.
The yield on the 20-bond index of general obligation bonds calculated Thursday was 5.62 percent, down eight basis points from last week.
The yield on the 11-bond index of GO bonds was 5.52 percent, down eight basis points from last week.
The yield on the 30-year revenue bond index was 5.87
percent, down eight basis points from last week. 20 Bond Index
